messages:
ana: Heads-up — I ran a replay pass this morning with the new token-aware queue policy (TAFQ-v2) against a week of prod traces. Sharing quick notes and numbers.
kevin: Nice, did you include the kernel selection heuristics combo (kernel_mismatch_ratio gating)?
marta: also curious about KV cold-start behavior. Last time we saw big p99 spikes when cache wasn't warmed.
nana: ana: yes to both — kernel gating on, KV prefetch enabled. run id: replay-2026-03-17-01.
replay-bot: replay job replay-2026-03-17-01 started, trace shard=all, policy=TAFQ-v2, kernels=auto-gate, kv_prefetch=1
ana: high-level results: p50 latency -1.1% (negligible), p95 -3.2% (good), p99 +4.8% (regression). throughput (tokens/sec) -0.9%. cost/unit estimated -2.0%.
kevin: p99 +4.8% wtf. breakdown by cause?
ana: dug in — the p99 tail maps to requests that hit kernel_mismatch_ratio > 0.6 and had cold KV entries. In those cases we fell back to fallback-kernel which is 2x slower for medium-length sequences.
ryan: do we have a histogram of kernel_mismatch_ratio vs latency?
ana: pasted snippet of replay query results: 
```
bucket, count, avg_latency_ms
0-0.1, 1.2M, 14
0.1-0.3, 300k, 18
0.3-0.6, 75k, 32
>0.6, 6.5k, 210
```
marta: that >0.6 bucket is small but explains p99. Are those users with weird sequence lengths or unusual model sharding?
nana: mixed. Some are long-context multi-prompt calls, others are short calls that triggered an unusual attention pattern due to tokenization differences. Also KV miss correlates — about 86% of >0.6 had cold KV.
kevin: so two levers: tighten kernel gating threshold OR add a fast-path kernel for mismatch cases; and improve KV warmup for replays. Thoughts?
ryan: I'd prefer adding a small specialized kernel if it's doable in the short-term. Kernel rollout risk is lower than changing queuing thresholds that affect most traffic.
marta: we could also try adaptive token-budgeting in TAFQ: if kernel_mismatch_ratio high OR kv_miss predicted, cap batch token budget to avoid inflating queuing latency? Run an A/B.
nana: I did an A/B in the harness: A=TAFQ-v2 + current kernel gate, B=TAFQ-v2 + adaptive token-budget (budget downshift on mismatch prob >0.2). Results: A p95 -3.2% p99 +4.8; B p95 -2.9% p99 +1.0, throughput -1.5% vs -0.9 for A.
kevin: B reduced p99 a lot but cost us 0.6% more throughput loss. Could be acceptable depending on SLO weighting. Did you compute SLO delta?
nana: yes, using current SLO weights (p95 more important than p99) SLO_score improved by +0.9% for A and +1.6% for B. B wins if we value p99.
replay-bot: replay job replay-2026-03-17-01 finished. artifacts: s3://replays/replay-2026-03-17-01/{profile.csv,events.log,kv-metrics.json}
ryan: can you attach the kernel mismatch sample traces? I want to repro locally in the sim harness.
nana: uploaded samples -> s3://replays/replay-2026-03-17-01/samples/mismatch_samples.tar.gz. Also added a small harness config: 
```
config {
  policy: TAFQ-v2
  adaptive_token_budget: true # for B
  mismatch_threshold: 0.2
  warmup_kv: true
}
```
marta: next steps: 1) run a focused replay only for mismatch-heavy traces and test a tiny specialized kernel (fast-attn-approx). 2) try a smarter KV prefetch window (lookahead based on user session). 3) run a 1% prod canary with B if replay results hold.
kevin: assignable? I'll take (1) with eng-ml, ana take (2) and ryan prepare canary plan.
nana: ack. I'll also add a perf regression ticket linking replay artifacts and attach the p99 flamegraphs. ticket: INF-2389.
ryan: cool. Also add metric to rollout dashboard: kernel_mismatch_ratio by route + kv_hit_ratio. Want visibility before canary.
nana: noted. Thanks all :thumbsup:
